name: Compute Cluster S02: NaN Guarding
description: Tests: is_valid() guard in conditions, NaN-safe ternary patterns.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S02: NaN Guarding
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
vol = volatility(period=21)(close)

# is_valid() guards NaN — prevents NaN propagation in conditions
low_vol = is_valid(vol) and vol < 0.15

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='NaN-Safe Low Vol Flag',
    category='NaN Guard',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Volatility', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=vol)
